strategy.rule: NK sir (video SMky9fADQZw): BUY the discounted far-expiry NIFTY option (fair value from near-month IV), SELL nearer-weekly premium against it — buyer at discount + seller at price. Discounted CALL -> 1:2 ratio (profits if market falls OR rises; only fast momentum hurts). Discounted PUT -> spread. Shorts 1:1 (defined risk). S4 regime switch (7 Nov replay): when the NIFTY spot 3-day return > +1.5% (trending rally) the desk enters the FAR LEG ONLY — the Nov 2-6 -75k came from call calendars re-entered daily into a rally. 3 lots (225 qty) per Rs 5L model book.
strategy.exits: target +70 pts · time-stop 4 trading days · momentum exit on close through the short strike +/-25 pt buffer · expired shorts rolled to the next weekly (keep selling)
